rock_bottom.climbTagline: You are at the floor of the climb. The only way out is through.

broke.climbTagline: The first real dent — proof the system can move.

struggling.climbTagline: Momentum is fragile but real; protect the trend.

surviving.climbTagline: The floor steadies — consistency starts to compound.

stabilizing.climbTagline: The climb feels calmer; guard the rhythm.

stable.climbTagline: You can see the other side — stay disciplined.

building.climbTagline: Identity shifts — you are building, not just surviving.

thriving.climbTagline: Rare air — defend what you earned.

winning.climbTagline: The finish line is visible — close it out.

wealthy.climbTagline: Debt at zero: the climb becomes maintenance, then rebuilding.
